name: Ikusabe Takamaru
source:
The protagonist of this story. By way of a ritual called Dragon Synergy (which is essentially sex), he can give his sexual partners a supernatural energy called Sex Power.

Although not initially aware of it himself, he’s lined up to become the 23rd master of the ninja clan known as the Crescent Moons, and fated to fight Noroi. Upon Haruka’s appearance, he was determined, if not bewildered by the revelations, to fight the Noroi Faction.
